title: BPW-2026-0571
text:
[JOINT REPORT(S)]
BPW-2026-0571
BOE + BCA
CD 9
SOLE SOURCE CONTRACT – DAVID P. DAPPER – LOS ANGELES CONVENTION CENTER EXPANSION AND MODERNIZATION PROJECT
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to negotiate a sole source contract with David P. Dapper for Project Neutral Services for the Los Angeles Convention Center Expansion and Modernization Project for $600,000, with a budget authority not-to-exceed the amount of $300,000, to be funded by the City of Los Angeles and equally matched by Plenary Americas Conventions Los Angeles, LLC formerly known as AEG Plenary Conventions Los Angeles, LLC at an amount not-to-exceed $300,000.
